title: Rockslug

additionalFacts.text: Use a bag of salt at 4 Hitpoints or lower, or use a brine sabre to finish the kill.
support: bag of salt must be used on it when it has 4 or less Hitpoints
brine sabre can be used to kill them without the need for bags of salt
